title: Oceanography CTDCruiseStations

stats.done_summary: Completed CTD cruise station analysis. Implemented reproducible pipeline in code/ctd_analysis.py to QC cruise_ctd.csv, derive TEOS-10 variables (SA, CT, sigma0), compute per-profile summaries (MLD, thermocline depth, N^2), and generate figures (station map, profiles, TS diagram, sections, MLD, along-track surface variability, validation) saved to report/images. Wrote publication-style report to report/report.md and saved intermediate outputs to outputs/.
